# proxmox_ceph_status (Data Source)

Reads the raw Ceph cluster status JSON from `/cluster/ceph/status`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_ceph_status" "s" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) JSON object of the full Ceph status.
